task.name: pick_marker_draw_line
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the marker from the cup, draw a line on the table and put it back into the cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the marker in the cup.
2. Grasp the marker from the cup.
3. Move the left arm to position the marker on the table.
4. Draw a line on the table with the marker.
5. Move the left arm to align with the cup.
6. Release the gripper to put the marker back into the cup.
